chapter.verse: Topa aw, ka galte tam mahmah! Mi tampi in kei hong langpan’ nainai hi.
“Pasian in amah huh lo ding,” mi tampi in hong ci uh hi.
Ahih hangin, Topa aw, nangmah in ka kidalna lum, ka minthan’na leh ka lu hong phongpa na hi hi.
Nakpi in Topa ka gal sap a, amah in a mual siangtho panin hong dawng hi.
Lum-in ka ihmu a, Topa in hong kem ahih manin ka thokik hi.
Keimah hong galbawl, hong umcih mi tulsawm tampite ka kihta kei hi.
Tho in, Topa! Kei hong hon in, ka Pasian! Bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in ka galte khempeuh’ paang na satgawp a, migilote’ ha na su-tan hi.
Hotkhiatna in Topa, Nangma hang ahi hi; na mite tungah na thupha hong tung ta hen!
